aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases leverage and concentration in high-scoring setups. Be aware that this approach carries substantially higher drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs are subject to daily decay and rebalancing, which can lead to rapid losses if not managed with strict stop discipline.

income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income from covered-call ETFs. While aiming for steady distributions, remember these are variable, and NAV can still decline in market selloffs; this is not a savings account.
